scope: Only typed native footnote-divider recovery and general compact formal-identifier schema; all geometry/prose/mask rules inherited unchanged.
divider_rule: One nonwhite horizontal native line stroke,length>=5bodyems,width<=.1bodyem. An unseeded final component must lie entirely in its one-pixel-supported stroke envelope, touch no other semantic seed, and have one detected footnote below within2ems with>=half horizontal overlap and no competing region overlap. All other unknown ink still refuses.
identifier_schema: Delimited decimal/section-decimal with optional letter prefix/suffix, Roman or symbolic tag; bare integer remains margin-constrained. External glyph-core requirement unchanged.
stop: One pass on2seenregressions+1newsource; no post-output rules. Controls do not count as real generalization.
